description: A story component for the '@superset-ui/time-format' package demonstrating a time format validator UI with sample date inputs and formatted outputs.

classes.name: TimeFormatValidator
classes.description: React component providing a UI to test and preview date/time formatting using user-specified format strings.

methods.description: Renders the UI including input for format string and table displaying formatted test values.
